description: This file defines the LogLocator enum which manages log file locations, ensuring directory existence, retrieving the most recent log file, and providing log paths for launchd jobs.

methods.name: logDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for logs, either from environment variable 'OPENCLAW_LOG_DIR' or defaulting to '/tmp/openclaw'.

methods.name: stdoutLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the stdout log file within the log directory.

methods.name: gatewayLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the gateway log file within the log directory.

methods.name: ensureLogDirExists
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not already exist.

methods.name: modificationDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modification date of a log file, defaulting to distantPast if inaccessible.

methods.name: bestLogFile
methods.description: Returns the URL of the most recent log file matching specific prefixes within the log directory, or nil if none found.

methods.name: launchdLogPath
methods.description: Provides the path used for launchd stdout/err, ensuring directory exists before returning.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Provides the path used for Gateway launchd job stdout/err, ensuring directory exists before returning.
